class.name: SteamSocketListener
class.brief_description: A standalone listener with explicit admission.
class.description: Observe [signal connection_requested] and apply a local allowlist or equivalent session policy. Pending offers expire after 1.5 seconds and count against this listener's remote limit.

method.name: accept
method.description: Accepts the exact live offer on its original listener. Successful acceptance issues a handle that can be closed immediately. Wait for [signal SteamSocketConnection.connected] before using its authenticated identity or sending.

method.name: reject
method.description: Rejects and retires the exact pending offer.

method.name: close
method.description: Closes this listener and retires its pending offers and accepted connections.

signal.name: connection_requested
signal.description: Emitted for a new pending offer. Handle it within its monotonic deadline.
